notes: A 401 body (see meta.json): its integer code is gap OR1, so it comes back as a 502. Not recordable: the recorder sends a valid key.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap OR1: OpenRouter's error code is an integer (the HTTP status) and models.ErrorDetail.Code a string, so parseProviderError cannot decode any OpenRouter error body and falls back to a 502: a 400, 401, 402 or 429 is retried, failed over and counted against the circuit breaker, and the client gets the raw body as the message
